{"title":"Oura","description":"Oura proprietary scores (Readiness, Resilience, Cardiovascular Age, SpO2) with contributor breakdowns + trends.","defaults":{"dataSources":{"ds.search":{"options":{"queryParameters":{"latest":"$global_time.latest$","earliest":"$global_time.earliest$"}}}},"visualizations":{"global":{"showProgressBar":true}}},"inputs":{"input_global_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"global_time","defaultValue":"-30d@d,now"},"title":"Time Range"},"input_person":{"type":"input.dropdown","title":"Person (temp)","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_person_list"},"options":{"token":"person","selectFirstSearchResult":true},"encoding":{"value":"primary.person_id","label":"primary.person_name"}}},"dataSources":{"ds_person_list":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"| tstats count where `widx` by person_id

| eval is_self=if(splunk_user=="$env:user$",0,1)
| sort is_self person_name
| table person_id person_name"},"name":"People"},"ds_readiness":{"type":"ds.search","options":{"query":"`widx` tag=wearable_daily vendor=oura person_id="$person$"

| eval rcolor=case(resilience_level="limited","#E8503A",resilience_level="adequate","#E8843A",resilience_level="solid","#F4A422",resilience_level="strong","#4CAF50",resilience_level="exceptional","#4CAF50",true(),"#8a93a0")

| table day Recommendation Status"},"name":"Sleep-time recommendations (recent)"}},"visualizations":{"intro_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","markdown":"# Oura — proprietary scores

(recent)","hideWhenNoData":true},"glossary_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","markdown":"### About these metrics
- **Readiness** — Oura's daily 0–100 estimate of how recovered/ready you are. **↑ higher is better**. Built from the contributors below.
- **Readiness contributors** — the sub-signals Oura blends in: body temperature, HRV balance, resting HR, recovery index. **↑ higher is better** for each (each is a 0–100-ish sub-score).
- **Resilience** — longer-term capacity to handle stress: limited → adequate → solid → strong → exceptional. **higher tier is better**. Driven by sleep recovery, daytime recovery, and stress load.
- **Vascular (cardiovascular) age** — Oura's estimate of your arterial age from overnight pulse-wave data. **↓ lower is better** — younger than your real age is the goal (compare on the Heart page).
- **SpO2** — blood-oxygen saturation overnight. **↑ higher is better** — ~95–100% is typical; sustained dips can flag breathing issues.
- **Sleep-time recommendation** — Oura's suggested bedtime window and whether you followed it. **'optimal'/'good' is better** than 'pay attention'.

_These are Oura-specific scores; the cross-vendor Wellness and Heart pages show the same latest values against other vendors. Requires an Oura ring (Cardiovascular Age + Resilience may need extra API token scopes)._

**Learn more:** [Oura — Readiness](https://support.ouraring.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025589793-Readiness-Score)"}}},"layout":{"type":"absolute","options":{"width":1440,"height":1660,"display":"auto"},"structure":[{"item":"intro_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":20,"w":1400,"h":120}},{"item":"readiness_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":160,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"resilience_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":370,"y":160,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"vascage_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":720,"y":160,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"spo2_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":1070,"y":160,"w":350,"h":150}},{"item":"readiness_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":330,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"readiness_contrib","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":330,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"resilience_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":650,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"vascage_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":650,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"spo2_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":970,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"sleeptime","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":970,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"glossary_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1290,"w":1400,"h":340}}],"globalInputs":["input_global_trp","input_person"]}}
